item.title: Disappointed
item.author: example@test.com (Mongoose Studios)
item.description:
A lot has happened in the past couple of days, and it didn’t feel right to post what I had prepared as a result.

I am not a political person. I do not choose to engage in politics.

I can find agreement and strong disagreement with various positions and core ideals of “both sides.”

I say this because I want you to understand where I am coming from, or more specifically where I am not coming from.
